origin.construction: Superseded-repair adapts the historical open state of Leaf4247 after PR4261 was superseded by merged4331; the live issue was later closed. Names and IDs are synthetic. The same resolved issue is assessed at both triage and nightly entrypoints. Contrasts protect partial/intermittent unresolved work and an accepted active repair handoff. Current-state reads are frozen; no production execution is simulated.
